# Alembic fixtures

## `procedural-static`

`scene.abc`, **CC0-1.0**, taken as-is from the local corpus `test/assets/alembic/procedural-static`
(generated by `test/assets/tools/model_formats_blender.py`, WebGeometry corpus, 15 September 2026,
exported by Blender 5.2.1 LTS through Alembic 1.8.3). The repository ignores `test/assets/`: the
file is copied here with its notice, `LICENSE.txt`, without changing anything — 8,110 bytes, Ogawa
container, format version 256.

What it carries, and what the golden pins in the clear:

- a root `Xform` `HierarchyRoot`, three `Xform` `SharedMesh_0`, `SharedMesh_1`, `SharedMesh_2`
  placed at x = 0, 3 and 6 — the identity matrix of the first and of the root is not written in the
  glTF, which implies it;
- under each, a `PolyMesh` `Cube`: 8 positions, 6 four-sided faces, normals and texture
  coordinates per face corner, the latter indexed on 14 unique values;
- three `FaceSet` per cube — `Emissive` (faces 2 and 5), `Opaque` (0 and 3), `Transparent` (1 and 4) —
  hence three primitives per mesh and one material per name, shared by the three cubes;
- the three cubes have the same bytes: a single mesh is written, and the two repetitions are
  nothing more than nodes. 36 triangles in total, 3 materials, 9 face sets read.

## `limites`

Two headers written by hand for this repository, under the same CC0-1.0 licence, that carry no
geometry: `hdf5.abc` opens on the HDF5 container magic, Alembic's historical
wrapper that this binary does not read, and `truncated.abc` on a complete Ogawa header whose root
group is past the end of the file. Each proves a named rejection through the whole compiler
— `alembic-hdf5-unsupported` and `alembic-file-invalid` — and not through the reader alone.
